about: MASTER_PLAN.md §4.1: every threshold of the Walker Test. Ids are never removed; metric, unit, axis, scope, op and sample never change (tool too, once a row is partial or built); values only tighten; sample_min never falls. Status is derived from evidence (REVIEWS/evidence/**/<id>.json written by the row's tool) and may always be demoted. A loosening needs "loosened_by": a UD-nn whose own text names the id and the new value; a threshold proven wrong in principle takes "superseded_by" with gates/errata/<id>.md. tests/gates_ratchet.test.ts enforces this against git history and the ratchet/* tags, and fails closed.

thresholds.metric: hard breaks per area
thresholds.sample: bot-hours per area (wanderer, tourist, follower, returner policies)
thresholds.anti_proxy: a bot that walks only the built parts says nothing of the rest: bots spawn over the whole area registry

thresholds.metric: hard breaks world-wide
thresholds.anti_proxy: world-wide hours can be piled up in the easy areas: the per-area row T-H0 must hold too

thresholds.metric: soft breaks per bot-hour per area
thresholds.anti_proxy: soft breaks counted only by detectors that exist: every escape found by a reviewer adds a detector (T-R0)

thresholds.metric: Tier-1 hard fails in the seeded random sample per area or generator class
thresholds.sample: random views per area (sampler seeded by the commit hash; <5 % failure at 95 % confidence)
thresholds.anti_proxy: worst-first views are reported apart and never counted in the pass rate

thresholds.metric: Tier-1 hard fails in the reference transect
thresholds.sample: random views over the transect (<2 % at 95 %)
thresholds.anti_proxy: the transect is the reference; a transect sample chosen by the agent would flatter it, so the commit-hash seed picks it

thresholds.metric: untiered or placeholder pixels
thresholds.anti_proxy: flags lie (3,983 unflagged village boxes): measure detail per steradian too

thresholds.metric: drawn meshes carrying tier and source
thresholds.sample: every drawn mesh in the registry
thresholds.anti_proxy: a tier tag on a group does not tier the meshes inside it: counted per drawn mesh, not per parent

thresholds.metric: flat-region share (connected >= 2 % of frame with 12 px Ystd/Y < 0.03, sky excluded)
thresholds.anti_proxy: procedural noise defeats a flatness check: paired with T-A2s

thresholds.metric: frames whose power-spectrum slope and 12 px Ystd/Y lie in the 5-95 % band of the reference photographs at the same distance class
thresholds.anti_proxy: calibrated on references/ and the user photographs, never on renders

thresholds.metric: clipped pixels (any channel >= 254, sun disc and flames excluded)
thresholds.anti_proxy: a frame can avoid clipping by dimming everything: T-A2s2 and the rubric judge the tone as well

thresholds.metric: black crush by day
thresholds.anti_proxy: night is judged by T-B2, never brightened to pass this

thresholds.metric: NaN or black tiles
thresholds.anti_proxy: a NaN tile hidden by TRAA history reappears in motion: checked in clips too, not only stills

thresholds.metric: lowest rubric category score in any judged view
thresholds.sample: Tier-2 views per session (calibrated, blind reviewer)
thresholds.anti_proxy: judged as scenes in motion with sound, not stills

thresholds.metric: judged views that read as CG
thresholds.anti_proxy: a reviewer told which frames are renders is lenient: judged blind among anchors and photographs (§8)

thresholds.metric: paired photo test: blind reviewer pick accuracy (render vs site photograph from its solved camera)
thresholds.anti_proxy: ratchets down every time it improves; 50 % is indistinguishable

thresholds.metric: area registry union cover of the physically walkable envelope
thresholds.sample: the envelope from slope, step-up and colliders, not the nav grid
thresholds.anti_proxy: a denominator the build defines for itself always looks good

thresholds.metric: largest area (0.25 ha for interiors)
thresholds.anti_proxy: big areas dilute a failing village

thresholds.metric: months hit per area within one rotation
thresholds.anti_proxy: weather sampled by climate frequency with a floor for rare states

thresholds.metric: hour bands hit per area within one rotation (pre-dawn, dawn, morning, noon, afternoon, dusk, moonlit night, moonless night)
thresholds.anti_proxy: hour bands hit only in clear weather are not coverage: the pairwise array covers hour x weather

thresholds.metric: weather states hit per area within one rotation (clear, cloud, overcast, rain, storm, snow, dust, mist, lightning)
thresholds.anti_proxy: a weather state drawn so faint it does not show passes a count: the frame must show the state (reviewer check)

thresholds.metric: world-level pairwise coverage (hour x weather, month x hour, area class x weather)
thresholds.anti_proxy: marginals can be hit while combinations (night x rain, winter x dusk) are never seen: pairwise, not marginal

thresholds.metric: moonless night away from fire: tone-mapped mean luma
thresholds.anti_proxy: stops night being brightened until it looks like dusk

thresholds.metric: full-moon night away from fire: tone-mapped mean luma
thresholds.anti_proxy: moonlight brightened to dusk passes a mean: paired with the lower bound T-B2s so night is neither dusk nor black

thresholds.metric: sessions for a full Tier-1 rotation of every area
thresholds.anti_proxy: a rotation finished by dropping areas from the registry: the registry cannot shrink (tests/areas.test.ts)

thresholds.metric: age of carried (canary-checked) evidence before it reads STALE
thresholds.anti_proxy: STALE counts as FAIL

thresholds.metric: people hidden near the lens in judged views (rigClear)
thresholds.anti_proxy: a person hidden by moving the camera is still hidden: rigClear is counted, not worked around

thresholds.metric: 1440p detail tiles per session (setViewOffset sub-rectangles)
thresholds.anti_proxy: tiles chosen from the prettiest regions: tile rectangles are drawn by the seeded sampler

thresholds.metric: ultra views at the player default FOV and at the widest setting per session
thresholds.anti_proxy: a flattering lens hides what the player sees

thresholds.metric: motion clips per session (48 frames, 480x270, walking 1.35 m/s, ID pass per frame)
thresholds.anti_proxy: clips that walk empty ground show no pop or sliding: clips follow the seeded walker paths through crowds

thresholds.metric: object or person pops inside 50 m per clip
thresholds.anti_proxy: pops can be hidden by a fade: a fade inside 50 m of the player counts as a pop

thresholds.metric: temporal flicker in static regions, as a multiple of a static-camera baseline clip
thresholds.anti_proxy: a blurrier TRAA hides flicker by smearing detail: T-A2s2 judges the same frames for detail

thresholds.metric: people interpenetrating another or the player by more than 0.2 m
thresholds.sample: bot-hours of renderless traces from the crowd instance buffers
thresholds.anti_proxy: traces read what is drawn, not the plan

thresholds.metric: walking pairs closer than 0.4 m
thresholds.anti_proxy: pairs can be kept apart by emptying the lanes: crowd density per place class is judged too (rubric life category)

thresholds.metric: people walking in place (treadmill)
thresholds.anti_proxy: a treadmill walker hidden behind an impostor at distance is still one: traced at every distance

thresholds.metric: people drawn standing while their plan is active work
thresholds.anti_proxy: the frozen distant workers (audit C)

thresholds.metric: walk gait faster than 2.0 m/s
thresholds.anti_proxy: an agent teleported in small steps passes a speed check: T-D2j catches jumps, the trace samples every frame

thresholds.metric: jumps over 3 m in 1 s within 150 m of the player
thresholds.anti_proxy: jumps hidden outside the view cone reappear when the player turns: traced for all drawn people, not only in view

thresholds.metric: people drawn outdoors whose plan says indoors
thresholds.anti_proxy: the plan sheltered them while the screen showed them in the rain

thresholds.metric: household members whose plan says asleep at home drawn asleep there at 23:00
thresholds.anti_proxy: the sleeper hidden (not drawn) passes a count of people outdoors: asleep must be drawn asleep where they sleep

thresholds.metric: people in the open in rain >= 0.5 (jobs exempted by evidence) as a share of the dry-day count
thresholds.anti_proxy: emptying the scene in rain (hiding people) passes a share: the hidden must be drawn under cover, indoors or on their way

thresholds.metric: herders or ploughmen in view without their animals, any distance
thresholds.anti_proxy: a herder drawn with one token sheep passes: the flock size must match the herd in the simulation

thresholds.metric: twin pairs (closer than the face JND) among people within 15 m of the player
thresholds.anti_proxy: faces and bodies are continuous per-person parameters, not picks from variants

thresholds.metric: lineups of 20 crops from one crowd in which a reviewer finds a twin pair
thresholds.anti_proxy: lineups made of dissimilar crowds are easy: crops are drawn from one place and moment

thresholds.metric: largest share of one name in a (sex, origin) group of over 2,000 people
thresholds.anti_proxy: attested names before reconstructed; the census reports each share

thresholds.metric: living household members sharing a name where the evidence does not attest the practice
thresholds.anti_proxy: two sisters named apart by one letter pass a string check: names compared by root, not spelling

thresholds.metric: people with >= 5 history events consistent with age, kin and the archive dates
thresholds.anti_proxy: a templated sentence fills a field: consistency is tested (birth order, mother 14-45, arrival before job)

thresholds.metric: pairs of people sharing an identical event-type sequence of length 4
thresholds.anti_proxy: event types split finely make sequences look distinct: the type list is locked in data (event kinds)

thresholds.metric: people showing a trace of their history a walker can see or hear
thresholds.anti_proxy: mourning dress, a limp, a foreign accent, a craft mark, a keepsake, a greeting for an old friend

thresholds.metric: on-screen household traces matching the kin graph (children with their own mother or kin, meals together)
thresholds.anti_proxy: households traced only by day hide missing nights: the 7 days include nights and meals

thresholds.metric: image-patch SSIM between two instances of one generator within 50 m (matched viewpoint and light)
thresholds.anti_proxy: resized copies of one kit pass a count of distinct geometries; they do not pass this

thresholds.metric: identical (person, act, metre) share at one place and hour across 7 days
thresholds.anti_proxy: measured on acts, events and changes, not who stands where

thresholds.metric: 2-hour daytime windows per area with no non-routine witnessable event within 100 m
thresholds.anti_proxy: a scripted event near the player passes a window: events arise from world state, never the player (T-F6)

thresholds.metric: seeds per people gate (one a fresh random seed each run, logged)
thresholds.anti_proxy: tuning to seed 1 shows

thresholds.metric: witnessable stages per system in data/systems.json, each at a registry place
thresholds.anti_proxy: five standing people with baskets are not a market

thresholds.metric: drawn store vs simulated stock
thresholds.anti_proxy: goods never appear or vanish without a carrier

thresholds.metric: monthly flow imbalance of goods
thresholds.anti_proxy: flows balanced by an accounting fudge term: every unit has a carrier or a store on record

thresholds.metric: road density within 1 km on a delegation arrival, as a multiple of an ordinary day
thresholds.anti_proxy: measured on screen (crowd buffers), not in a simulation variable

thresholds.metric: guard posts on a delegation arrival, as a multiple
thresholds.anti_proxy: guards doubled in data but not drawn: counted on screen from the crowd buffers

thresholds.metric: minutes for outdoor work to drop after a storm begins
thresholds.anti_proxy: work drops in the plan but figures stay drawn at work: measured on screen (see T-F3s2 for in-game minutes)

thresholds.metric: kinds of emergent incident arising from system state (not the calendar)
thresholds.anti_proxy: fifteen kinds that are variants of one (a jar spilled here, there): kinds must differ visibly, reviewer-confirmed

thresholds.metric: arrivals whose news reaches people through visible messengers before the event
thresholds.anti_proxy: messengers drawn but arriving after the crowd: order of arrival is checked from the world log

thresholds.metric: world event-log differences between two different player paths at one seed (reactions to the player excepted)
thresholds.anti_proxy: the world never performs for the player (brief 1.1)

thresholds.metric: true peak
thresholds.anti_proxy: a limiter is present

thresholds.metric: cells whose integrated loudness falls outside their place-class band (bands set once from references, then locked)
thresholds.anti_proxy: bands set where the build already stands: fixed from published field levels before the first measurement

thresholds.metric: audio segments (xcorr > 0.9 over > 0.3 s) repeating within 60 s
thresholds.anti_proxy: repeats hidden by pitch-shifting one sample: cross-correlation after pitch normalisation

thresholds.metric: correlation between consecutive footsteps
thresholds.anti_proxy: two alternating footstep samples pass a consecutive-pair test: all steps within 10 s compared

thresholds.metric: shortest non-generative bed loop
thresholds.anti_proxy: a 30 s loop of a 5 s loop repeated: repetition measured inside the bed too (T-G2)

thresholds.metric: visible speakers within 15 m audible (> -40 dB at the listener)
thresholds.anti_proxy: every speaker made audible by raising all voices: the mix is judged by the listening rubric (T-G4)

thresholds.metric: visible fires within 10 m and rivers within 50 m audible
thresholds.anti_proxy: a fire made audible by one global crackle: the source must be located at the fire (HRTF position)

thresholds.metric: lowest listening-rubric category (presence, place, variety, mix, language, restraint)
thresholds.anti_proxy: "the audio context is running" is not listening

thresholds.metric: time below the quiet floor in night-field cells
thresholds.anti_proxy: silence reached by muting the world: the quiet floor is defined relative to the town day (T-G5d)

thresholds.metric: detector escapes (failures a reviewer or the user found that the detectors passed)
thresholds.anti_proxy: every escape is closed only by a new or tightened detector

thresholds.metric: anchor-set score deviation from its pins (else the session scores are void)
thresholds.anti_proxy: anchors re-pinned to match a lenient session: pins are locked with the anchor set, changed only by an audit round

thresholds.metric: sessions between full independent audit rounds and plan critiques
thresholds.anti_proxy: the builder never judges its own done

thresholds.metric: player-visible changes shipped per session, named first in PROGRESS
thresholds.anti_proxy: a "visible change" nobody would notice: named first in PROGRESS with before/after evidence paths

thresholds.metric: collider vs drawn ground height at the terrain LOD seams
thresholds.anti_proxy: the player fell through Kuh-e Rahmat at 12 of 24 crossings

thresholds.metric: random reachable targets reached per area
thresholds.anti_proxy: targets drawn only where bots already walk: targets are drawn over the area registry, not the nav grid

thresholds.metric: bot time stuck
thresholds.anti_proxy: stuck bots respawned before 10 s are hidden: every respawn is logged as stuck

thresholds.metric: main-thread frames over 33 ms caused by the simulation at x1
thresholds.anti_proxy: the simulation throttled (fewer people updated) to meet frame time: the soak gates and T-D traces must still pass

thresholds.metric: p99 frame time at x60
thresholds.anti_proxy: x60 p99 met by skipping simulation steps: step counts are checked against wall time

thresholds.metric: autosave interval (and on visibilitychange)
thresholds.anti_proxy: autosave that writes nothing useful (only the clock): T-H3r requires the full state round-trip

thresholds.metric: save -> load -> save byte differences (people, memory, doors, events)
thresholds.anti_proxy: byte-identical because the save omits people and memory: the save schema is checked for every system

thresholds.metric: load to first frame on an idle box (SwiftShader)
thresholds.anti_proxy: a two-minute loading screen breaks the time capsule before it begins

thresholds.metric: blocklist hits in the judged sample visual checklist
thresholds.anti_proxy: a checklist only of what reviewers remember: the blocklist file is the checklist, item by item

thresholds.metric: fate-hint strings in speech, chronicle or translation layer
thresholds.anti_proxy: the world never hints at its fate

thresholds.metric: modern-language hits in the world (lint:lang inside npm run build)
thresholds.anti_proxy: a lint that exempts files: every in-world string source is listed and scanned

thresholds.metric: data records without a tier
thresholds.anti_proxy: records tiered with a default value: a default tier counts as untiered

thresholds.metric: new (event kind x place class x state) triples found per hour after 10 bot-hours at x1
thresholds.anti_proxy: kinds split only with a reviewer-confirmed visible difference

thresholds.metric: new triples per hour after 50 bot-hours
thresholds.anti_proxy: kinds invented late in the run to keep novelty up: the kind list is locked before the run

thresholds.metric: rare-tail kinds (expected less than once per 10 hours of play)
thresholds.anti_proxy: rare kinds that never actually fire: each is shown firing at least once in a long soak with its expected rate

thresholds.metric: areas showing a change a walker can see after 30 in-game days away
thresholds.anti_proxy: change counted as any pixel difference (lighting, season): the change must be in the world state, not the sky

thresholds.metric: absence caught up deterministically (no freeze past a cap)
thresholds.anti_proxy: caught up by freezing people in place: superseded by T-J3e (equality with a continuous run)

thresholds.metric: similarity of day d and day d + one year above that of adjacent days
thresholds.anti_proxy: the calendar replayed after 354 days

thresholds.metric: witnessable surprises shipped per session, verified on screen (Tier-2 view or clip)
thresholds.anti_proxy: listing alone does not count

thresholds.metric: capture-recapture estimate of gaps still unfound, as a share of WORLD_INVENTORY
thresholds.anti_proxy: rows seeded from outside taxonomies (HRAF OCM, PF/PT commodity and occupation lists, brief 5.5)

thresholds.metric: sandbox verbs working where they make sense (address, inspect, follow, sit/wait/sleep, carry a sealed document, watch a craft)
thresholds.anti_proxy: "where it makes sense" defined narrowly to pass: the per-verb area-class list is locked in data/verbs.json

thresholds.metric: people within 3 m who can be addressed and answer in their language with gesture
thresholds.anti_proxy: no longer only the 135

thresholds.metric: repeated lines over 50 random addresses per area
thresholds.anti_proxy: repeats hidden by giving every person one line: repeats counted over lines heard, across people

thresholds.metric: days an addressed or obstructed person remembers the player
thresholds.anti_proxy: memory kept in data but never shown: the person reacts (greeting, avoidance) and the reaction is traced

thresholds.metric: default head-bob amplitude
thresholds.anti_proxy: bob small but with camera roll or FOV pumping: no roll, no FOV change while walking

thresholds.metric: comfort and access settings with an e2e test (head-bob, flash warning, key remap, mouse sensitivity, subtitles, colour-blind-safe UI)
thresholds.anti_proxy: settings with a test that only toggles the checkbox: each test checks the effect in the frame or the audio

thresholds.metric: JS heap growth per hour after warm-up in a 4-hour soak
thresholds.anti_proxy: no leaked audio nodes, no drift, saves byte-identical

thresholds.metric: leaked audio nodes after 4 hours
thresholds.anti_proxy: nodes disconnected but kept referenced leak memory: heap and node counts both tracked

thresholds.metric: playable static builds published per gate, with a what-changed / still-broken note
thresholds.anti_proxy: the user still has to play it

thresholds.metric: GPU cost model: predicted frame time on an RTX 3070 at 1440p in the 10 heaviest board views
thresholds.anti_proxy: triangles are not frame rates; the first real bench recalibrates it

thresholds.metric: per stratum (distance class x scene class x light): share of Tier-1 frames inside the joint 5-95 % band of the reference photographs, not below the references' own leave-one-out share by more than the binomial 95 % margin
thresholds.sample: Tier-1 frames per stratum; references: photographs only
thresholds.anti_proxy: a stratum judged against renders or paintings passes CG: photographs only (T-A2r), KS test as well (T-A2k)

thresholds.metric: strata where a two-sample KS test of either image statistic against the stratum's reference photographs rejects at alpha 0.05
thresholds.anti_proxy: a distribution with the right band but the wrong shape (all frames at one edge) passes a band share: KS tests shape

thresholds.metric: reference photographs (never renders) of the real place or a listed analogue per stratum judged by T-A2s2; fewer reads NOT-MEASURED
thresholds.anti_proxy: analogues chosen to look like the build: the analogue list (Fars and Zagros mud-brick settlements, Marvdasht, night, rain) is fixed first

thresholds.metric: flat-region share above the 95th percentile of the same-stratum reference photographs (the 3 % cap of T-A2f still applies)
thresholds.anti_proxy: flatness hidden by noise: paired with T-A2s2 on the same frames

thresholds.metric: clipped pixels (any channel >= 254), excluding the sun disc and 5 deg aureole, flames and specular glints under 4 px
thresholds.anti_proxy: exclusions widened until nothing counts: the excluded pixels are reported and capped at 2 % of the frame

thresholds.metric: blind pick accuracy between render and site photograph from its solved camera (the final standard)
thresholds.anti_proxy: pairs chosen where the render is best: pairs are all solved photographs, #24 first, not a selection

thresholds.metric: brief 1.1 moments judged per rotation as scenes in motion with sound, each with every rubric category >= 4
thresholds.anti_proxy: moments judged as stills at the rig lens: clips at the player's lens and quality, with sound

thresholds.metric: moonless skyline contrast (sky minus terrain luma after tone mapping); night must not be crushed to black
thresholds.anti_proxy: night brightened to pass: the upper bounds T-B2m and T-B2f hold on the same frames

thresholds.metric: full-moon frame mean luma away from fire (lower bound)
thresholds.anti_proxy: a moonlit night crushed to black passes T-B2f: this bounds it from below

thresholds.metric: conversation-distance clips per session (the player addresses a random person at 1-2 m, default FOV, ultra), each with every rubric category >= 4 and none uncanny
thresholds.anti_proxy: the prettiest face chosen for the clip: the person is drawn at random from those within 3 m

thresholds.metric: shadow review judged ON SCREEN: people followed in the browser whose day scores >= 4/5 against their plan
thresholds.anti_proxy: a text timeline reviewed instead of the screen: the review watches the drawn person

thresholds.metric: pairs of people within 15 m of the player closer than d* in the population-SD-scaled face and body parameter vector (head dimensions visible at 15 m); d* = distance at which blind reviewers say "same person" 50 % of the time on rendered head crops at 1 m and 5 m
thresholds.sample: bot-hours; d* refitted when the face model changes
thresholds.anti_proxy: dimensions that do not change the drawn head inflate distance: only drawn head dimensions count

thresholds.metric: 2-hour daytime windows in an inhabited area (Terrace, town, villages, roads) with no non-routine witnessable event within 100 m
thresholds.anti_proxy: events spawned for the window near the player: events arise from world state (T-F6)

thresholds.metric: 2-hour daytime windows in an unpeopled area with no witnessable sign of life or weather change within sight (a herd, a traveller, a raptor, a dust devil, a cloud shadow); silence itself is allowed (brief 1.1)
thresholds.anti_proxy: wilderness filled with staged events: only the world's own animals, travellers and weather count

thresholds.metric: in-game minutes for outdoor work to drop after a storm begins
thresholds.anti_proxy: work drops in the plan but figures stay drawn: measured on screen

thresholds.metric: on a short-ration month: ration-queue length as a multiple of a normal month (on screen)
thresholds.anti_proxy: the queue lengthened in data only: counted from the crowd buffers

thresholds.metric: on a short-ration month: jars carried home as a multiple of a normal month (on screen)
thresholds.anti_proxy: jars hidden rather than fewer issued: stores and issues balance (T-F2)

thresholds.metric: causal links named in brief 9.5 without a threshold row
thresholds.anti_proxy: a link defined away as not causal: the list is the brief's own text

thresholds.metric: event-log hash for (seed, day) differing between node and Chromium or from the committed golden hash
thresholds.anti_proxy: the golden hash re-committed to match a drift: a golden change needs a DECISIONS entry naming the cause

thresholds.metric: year-soak gates passed (brief 13.11: variety, stability, event floor, plan checks)
thresholds.anti_proxy: soak on seed 1 only: three seeds, one fresh

thresholds.metric: scheduled activities drawn with a placeholder performance (brief 9.5)
thresholds.anti_proxy: an activity mapped to a generic pose passes a placeholder count: impostor frames within 0.09 m of the cycle (D-229)

thresholds.metric: town daytime median integrated loudness at the calibrated master (town day = 60 dBA playback)
thresholds.anti_proxy: the calibration point moved to make other bands pass: fixed here

thresholds.metric: rural night cells outside 25-35 dBA (calibrated as T-G1t)
thresholds.anti_proxy: bands from published field levels, set before measurement; never where the build stands

thresholds.metric: village daytime cells outside 40-50 dBA (calibrated as T-G1t)
thresholds.anti_proxy: bands from published field levels, set before measurement

thresholds.metric: market or gathering cells outside 60-70 dBA (calibrated as T-G1t)
thresholds.anti_proxy: bands from published field levels, set before measurement

thresholds.metric: time in night-field cells with 3 s loudness at least 30 LU below the town daytime median
thresholds.anti_proxy: silence by muting the world: the night still holds its animals and wind (T-G3e, rubric)

thresholds.metric: segments over 2 s shared (xcorr > 0.9) by two performances of one piece (brief 11: repeat performances differ)
thresholds.anti_proxy: performances varied only in tempo: cross-correlation after time alignment

thresholds.metric: enterable spaces whose RT60 differs from its Sabine estimate (dimensions, materials) by more than 20 %
thresholds.anti_proxy: one reverb for every room passes a presence check: per-space RT60

thresholds.metric: sources behind at least one wall not >= 10 dB down and low-passed
thresholds.anti_proxy: occlusion only on the Terrace: every enterable space

thresholds.metric: hard breaks found by the prober bot (hugs walls, jumps in corners, times doors, pushes through queues, climbs 41-43 deg slopes, stands in doorways, near plane inside geometry)
thresholds.anti_proxy: well-behaved bots never probe edges: the prober is the adversary

thresholds.metric: p99 frame time at x600
thresholds.anti_proxy: x600 offered but never measured: measured like x60

thresholds.metric: save size after 100 bot-hours (IndexedDB; a failed save is announced out-of-world)
thresholds.anti_proxy: a save kept small by dropping memory and events: T-H3r round-trips the full state

thresholds.metric: saves from the previous published build that fail to load without an out-of-world notice
thresholds.anti_proxy: silent loss of a month-old world: migration or an announced loss

thresholds.metric: translation-layer strings without a source and tier
thresholds.anti_proxy: a default source tag on every string: a default counts as none

thresholds.metric: chronicle entries without a witnessable event at that place and time in the world log
thresholds.anti_proxy: the chronicle claiming what the world does not show (axis F anti-proxy)

thresholds.metric: people whose history, or reconstructions whose reasoning, cannot be reached in the translation layer
thresholds.anti_proxy: histories stored but unreachable: reached through the layer as a player would

thresholds.metric: attested named people placed outside their attested life window or role in 467
thresholds.anti_proxy: Fortification-archive people (509-493) placed without checking their dates: Treasury texts (492-458) are the right pool

thresholds.metric: Terrace plan overlay IoU against the published plans (brief 13.2)
thresholds.anti_proxy: overlay drawn from the build itself: against the published plans in research/

thresholds.metric: Terrace plan overlay offset (brief 13.2)
thresholds.anti_proxy: IoU passed with a shifted plan: offset bounded separately

thresholds.metric: sun position error against the ephemeris (brief 13.6)
thresholds.anti_proxy: checked at noon only: the whole year, every hour

thresholds.metric: monthly mean temperature error against the climate normals (brief 13.6)
thresholds.anti_proxy: the annual mean right, the months wrong: per month

thresholds.metric: monthly precipitation-day error against the climate normals (brief 13.6)
thresholds.anti_proxy: rain days right in total, wrong in season: per month

thresholds.metric: attested objects shown at their 467 point (tablets written and sealed with attested seals, foundation plates, Treasury objects)
thresholds.anti_proxy: objects shown out of their moment: each placed where and when the evidence puts it

thresholds.metric: absences of 1, 30, 354 and 3650 days whose loaded state differs from a continuous run from the same save (people, stores, construction, memory, events), or whose load with catch-up exceeds T-H4
thresholds.anti_proxy: catch-up by freezing: compared with a continuous run (the perpetual 467, D-246)

thresholds.metric: seeds where Jaccard(day d, day d + 354) over non-routine (event kind, area, hour band) and the daily weather sequence exceeds the 95th percentile of Jaccard(d, same calendar day in another seed)
thresholds.anti_proxy: routine calendar events count as sameness: only non-routine events and weather

thresholds.metric: addressed people who answer in another people's language (where no usable published corpus exists they answer with gesture and wordless voice; list in DECISIONS)
thresholds.anti_proxy: Aramaic murmur as a fallback for Lydians and Egyptians passes "answers": never another people's language

thresholds.metric: flashes per second with the flash warning set (WCAG 2.3.1), and full-field luminance jumps above the WCAG limit
thresholds.anti_proxy: the warning shown but the flashes unchanged: measured on the frames

thresholds.metric: meaningful sounds (speech, arrivals, alarms, animals) without a caption in the translation layer
thresholds.sample: every sound kind that carries news or life
thresholds.anti_proxy: captions for speech only: news and life are carried by other sounds too

thresholds.metric: playable builds published per session at a stable URL, with a note: what changed, what is still broken, three places and times worth walking to now
thresholds.anti_proxy: a build that loads but is not the current tree: the build names its commit

thresholds.metric: first-load download size
thresholds.anti_proxy: assets deferred until after the first frame and then stalling the walk: total over the first 10 minutes reported too

thresholds.metric: pipeline-compile hitches over 100 ms after the first 30 s on a real GPU (pre-warmed pipelines)
thresholds.anti_proxy: SwiftShader never shows compile hitches: measured on the user's bench run

thresholds.metric: GPU memory in the heaviest board view
thresholds.anti_proxy: memory counted only for textures: buffers and render targets too

thresholds.metric: absolute JS heap after 4 hours
thresholds.anti_proxy: growth bounded but the start already too high: an absolute ceiling

thresholds.metric: bench routes that run the simulation (court, town at dusk, rain on the plain, x60)
thresholds.anti_proxy: a bench without the simulation measures an empty world (audit D M3)

thresholds.metric: hard breaks in the WebGL2 fallback over the bench routes (brief 6: tested separately)
thresholds.anti_proxy: the fallback never run: it is a bench mode of its own

thresholds.metric: open critical findings from the latest independent review of any gate or area
thresholds.anti_proxy: critical findings downgraded to major by the lead: severity is the reviewer's

thresholds.metric: open findings of the representation review (brief 12: kurtas, children, punishment, women's dress, delegations, the living religion) run every audit round
thresholds.anti_proxy: a checklist written by the builder: drawn from brief 12 and the blocklist, judged by an independent reviewer

thresholds.metric: WORLD_INVENTORY rows marked MISSING for which a probable reconstruction exists (the gap rule, D-207)
thresholds.anti_proxy: a row marked ABSENT-BY-EVIDENCE to avoid building it: each absence cites the evidence that it was not there

thresholds.metric: court arrivals and departures a walker can witness per year in the default world (the court comes and goes by default, labelled C)
thresholds.anti_proxy: the court present from day 0 with only its departure simulated: the arrival must be an event with a before and after

thresholds.metric: decided defaults (DECISIONS entries that set one) not pinned by tests/defaults.test.ts
thresholds.anti_proxy: a decision logged but the code default left as it was: the test reads the code defaults

thresholds.metric: agent branches left unmerged and unrecorded at session close (autonomous work that silently vanishes)
thresholds.anti_proxy: a branch abandoned without a record: every reserved number names its branch and its fate

thresholds.metric: weakenings of the guard files found by the audit round's diff since the last audit (tests/gates_ratchet.test.ts, tests/scope_ledger.test.ts, vitest.config.ts, package.json, gates/, USER_DIRECTIONS.md, handoff templates, .githooks, .github)
thresholds.anti_proxy: guards edited in the same commit as a loosening: CI on every push and the audit diff see it

thresholds.metric: working rules of CLAUDE.md dropped or reworded without a user direction (scope phrases held for CLAUDE.md)
thresholds.anti_proxy: a rule kept in name but emptied: the rules' sentences are held verbatim

thresholds.metric: requests to the user for photographs or input beyond the easy list, or needing notes or links (UD-13)
thresholds.anti_proxy: hard asks hidden inside a long easy list: every item is something a person can take on a phone without instructions
